mentions.name: Search Hub
mentions.description: A highly customizable search hub that lets users query multiple search engines and AIs from one place. It runs entirely in the browser as a single HTML file with no telemetry or dependencies, and can be saved and run locally.
mentions.source_excerpt: http://search.future-secured.com - Search Hub for multiple search engines and AIs. Highly customizable. Everything stays in your browser, save and run locally if need be. Single HTML. No telemetry or dependencies.
